Name: Elizaphan, Father of Shemaiah
Summary: Father of Shemaiah the chief of the Elizaphanites.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:8: Father of Shemaiah the chief of the Elizaphanites.
LifeLesson: The mention of Elizaphan in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
